metadata.question: Was soil moisture higher at the Coastal Sage UCI station in California during January 2013 than during May 2013?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: We'll use the SMAP L3 soil moisture product (10 km daily). The question asks about a specific station near Irvine, CA. Date range will be Jan 2013 and May 2013. 2. Masking strategy: Soil-moisture data are passive-radar derived; no cloud masking required. We’ll just keep quality-flag = 0 and clip to a 10 km buffer around the station so we are not over-aggregated. 3. Logic: we take each image in Jan and May, impose the qa_flag=0 mask, clip, mean ~5 days period, and average within the month. If one collection is empty or produces 0 pixels, we return C1/C2. If the computed mean is NaN/None, C3. Otherwise compare. ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') pt = ee.Geometry.Point([-117.842, 33.68]) # Coastal Sage UCI station buffer = pt.buffer(10000) def mo_iter(iter, lst): d1 = ee.Date.fromYMD(2030, 1, 1).advance(iter, 'month') return lst.add(ee.Dictionary({ 'month': d1.get('year').format().cat('-').cat(d1.get('month').format('%02d')), 'col': ee.ImageCollection('NASA/SMAP/SPL3SMP_E/006') \ .filterBounds(buffer) \ .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(d1.get('year'), d1.get('year'), 'year')) \ .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(d1.get('month'), d1.get('month'), 'month')) \ .map(lambda img: img.select('soil_moisture_am').updateMask( img.select('retrieval_qual_flag_am').eq(0))) \ .map(lambda img: img.clip(buffer)) })) months = ee.List([]).iterate(ee.List([0, 4]).iterate(mo_iter, []), []) cols = ee.List(months).map(lambda d: ee.Dictionary(d).get('col')) def stat(col): n = ee.ImageCollection(col).size().getInfo() mean_val = ee.ImageCollection(col).mean() red = mean_val.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=buffer, scale=3000, maxPixels=1e9) sm = red.get('soil_moisture_am').getInfo() cnt = mean_val.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=buffer, scale=3000, maxPixels=1e9).get('soil_moisture_am').getInfo() return n if n>0 else None, sm, cnt jan_n, jan_sm, jan_cnt = stat(cols.get(0)) may_n, may_sm, may_cnt = stat(cols.get(1)) print(f"Jan2013 imgs:{jan_n}/{jan_cnt}, sm={jan_sm:.3f}") print(f"May2013 imgs:{may_n}/{may_cnt}, sm={may_sm:.3f}") if jan_n is None or may_n is None: print("C1") elif jan_cnt==0 or may_cnt==0 or jan_sm is None or may_sm is None or not isinstance(jan_sm,(float,int)) or not isinstance(may_sm,(float,int)): print("C3") elif jan_sm>may_sm: print("A") else: print("B") ```
data.code:
import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

pt = ee.Geometry.Point([-117.842, 33.68])  # Coastal Sage UCI station
buffer = pt.buffer(10000)

def mo_iter(iter, lst):
    d1 = ee.Date.fromYMD(2030, 1, 1).advance(iter, 'month')
    return lst.add(ee.Dictionary({
        'month': d1.get('year').format().cat('-').cat(d1.get('month').format('%02d')),
        'col': ee.ImageCollection('NASA/SMAP/SPL3SMP_E/006') \
                .filterBounds(buffer) \
                .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(d1.get('year'), d1.get('year'), 'year')) \
                .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(d1.get('month'), d1.get('month'), 'month')) \
                .map(lambda img: img.select('soil_moisture_am').updateMask(
                        img.select('retrieval_qual_flag_am').eq(0))) \
                .map(lambda img: img.clip(buffer))
    }))
months = ee.List([]).iterate(ee.List([0, 4]).iterate(mo_iter, []), [])
cols = ee.List(months).map(lambda d: ee.Dictionary(d).get('col'))

def stat(col):
    n = ee.ImageCollection(col).size().getInfo()
    mean_val = ee.ImageCollection(col).mean()
    red = mean_val.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
        geometry=buffer, scale=3000, maxPixels=1e9)
    sm = red.get('soil_moisture_am').getInfo()
    cnt = mean_val.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry=buffer, scale=3000, maxPixels=1e9).get('soil_moisture_am').getInfo()
    return n if n>0 else None, sm, cnt

jan_n, jan_sm, jan_cnt = stat(cols.get(0))
may_n, may_sm, may_cnt = stat(cols.get(1))

print(f"Jan2013 imgs:{jan_n}/{jan_cnt}, sm={jan_sm:.3f}")
print(f"May2013 imgs:{may_n}/{may_cnt}, sm={may_sm:.3f}")

if jan_n is None or may_n is None:
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
elif jan_cnt==0 or may_cnt==0 or jan_sm is None or may_sm is None or not isinstance(jan_sm,(float,int)) or not isinstance(may_sm,(float,int)):
    print("<answer>C3</answer>")
elif jan_sm>may_sm:
    print("<answer>A</answer>")
else:
    print("<answer>B</answer>")
